_comment: Map of the canvas app: data sources, screens, collections and globals.
This is documentation, not an importable file - a .msapp is a compiled binary
and is built in Power Apps Studio by following CANVAS_APP_BUILD.md.
Keep this file in step with the app. When someone has to change the app in two
years, this is the only thing that tells them which screen writes which list.

Licensing.Note: Standard connectors only. Confirm seeded Power Apps rights with your licensing owner before building.

DataSources.Name: Cell_Master
DataSources.Access: Read + Update (counter reset is done by Flow 5, never by the app)

Screens.Name: scrHome
Screens.Purpose: Pick technician name (mandatory, once per session). Entry point.

Screens.Name: scrMyList
Screens.Purpose: Allotted PM list, grouped by cell. Filter Task_Status <> Completed.

Screens.Name: scrScan
Screens.Purpose: Barcode reader. Resolves a scanned Machine_ID to the hub.

Screens.Name: scrMachineHub
Screens.Purpose: Machine identity, cell counter, open work order, five actions.

Screens.Name: scrChecklist
Screens.Purpose: One check point at a time with its acceptance standard on screen.

Screens.Name: scrSpare
Screens.Purpose: Request a part, showing current stock before asking.

Screens.Name: scrSpareUsed
Screens.Purpose: Record a part actually fitted, with failure mode.

Screens.Name: scrAbnormality
Screens.Purpose: Log a condition that is not yet a failure.

Screens.Name: scrDone
Screens.Purpose: Confirmation, with what happens next stated plainly.

Globals.Name: gblTech
Globals.Purpose: The selected technician. Set on scrHome, read by every write. The entire audit trail.

Globals.Name: gblMachine
Globals.Purpose: The machine currently in context, from the QR or the allotted list.

Globals.Name: gblCell
Globals.Purpose: That machine's cell, for the counter display.

Globals.Name: gblTask
Globals.Purpose: The open PM_Machine_Task for this machine, if any.

Globals.Name: gblSubmitting
Globals.Purpose: Disables the submit button while a write is in flight - stops the double-tap duplicate.

Collections.Name: colChecklist
Collections.Purpose: The check points for this machine's checklist set, with the technician's answers held before submission.

Collections.Name: colPendingWrites
Collections.Purpose: Rows captured while offline, replayed on reconnect. Persisted with SaveData.

Collections.Name: colTechs
Collections.Purpose: Cached active technicians, so the dropdown works offline.

Collections.Name: colMachines
Collections.Purpose: Cached machine master, so the hub renders offline.

OfflineStrategy.Persist: SaveData / LoadData on App.OnStart and App.OnClose
OfflineStrategy.Replay: colPendingWrites is replayed on scrHome.OnVisible when Connection.Connected is true
OfflineStrategy.Note: Offline capture is for the checklist and the abnormality log only. Anything needing a server-side lookup at the moment of capture - current stock on a spare request - is blocked offline rather than captured against a stale number.

Boundaries.TheAppDoesNotResetCounters: Cum_Std_Hours_Since_PM is only ever set to 0 by Flow 5, together with Last_PM_Date, Last_PM_WO_No, Reset_Applied and Reset_Date. The app writes task status; the flow decides what that means.
Boundaries.TheAppDoesNotCreateWorkOrders: Flow 2 owns work order creation, so the trigger rule lives in exactly one place.
Boundaries.TheAppDoesNotComputeCost: Total_Cost_INR is computed by Flow 8 from the master price at the time of use.
